bias.en: Uptrend pausing · on $571–572, below the 5- and 10-day
bias.zh: 上升趋势暂停 · 位于 $571–572，低于 5 日和 10 日均线

read.en: Berkshire Hathaway B slipped 0.4% on Nov 19 to $572.04, trading $565.60–573.13. It is below the 5-day ($583.8) and 10-day ($582.7), both still rising, and above the 30-day ($554.9), 100-day ($519.7) and 200-day ($502.2), all rising. MACD crossed below its signal on Nov 18, above zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 18 ($596.44), and RSI is 58.4, down from 80.0 five sessions ago.
read.zh: 伯克希尔 B 股 11月19日下跌 0.4%，收于 $572.04，盘中区间 $565.60–573.13。股价位于 5 日（$583.8）和 10 日均线（$582.7）下方，二者仍在上行；位于 30 日（$554.9）、100 日（$519.7）和 200 日均线（$502.2）上方，均在上行。MACD 于 11月18日下穿信号线，在零轴上方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月18日起看空（$596.44），RSI 为 58.4，五个交易日前为 80.0。

read.en: No level changed on the close: the $565.60 low dipped under the Nov 5 and 6 closes intraday, but the close held $570.9–572.3, and the $573.13 high stayed under the Nov 18 low. Resistance is $575.3–579.1 (Nov 9 and 4 closes), then $582.7–583.8 (10- and 5-day, Nov 18 high) and $588.2–590.2. Support is $570.9–572.3, then $562.5–565.6 (Nov 4, 9 and 19 lows) and $554.9 (30-day). A close above $579.1 would target $583.8; below $565.6, $562.5–554.9.
